caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass vase with a wide, flared mouth and narrow neck that curves outward into a rounded, bulbous body before tapering to a sturdy, circular base. The vase’s surface features undulating, ribbon-like decorative elements that encircle the middle of the body, giving it a textured appearance. The color is a light blue-green, with shading and highlights suggesting the reflective qualities of glass. The vase is centered on a plain, off-white background with no other objects or elements present. The artist's signature is visible near the base of the vase.
title: Green Glass Vase
